sermon.title: God the Father Imparts His Faith to Mankind — February 21, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that belief is imparted by God the Father, not conjured. Peter’s confession was revealed by the Father; Nathanael believed when Jesus saw him under the fig tree; the disciples believed at Cana. Jesus did not commit Himself to the crowds. Signs have not ceased, and the church should not divide over nonsense.
